title: Classic Games — Open Source Remakes & Free Playables
note: the early digital era, remeshed inside. the Oregon Trail IS the membrane. you start with supplies, make choices, die of dysentery. sound familiar?

educational_mecc.label: MECC Educational (19711996)
educational_mecc.note: Minnesota Educational Computing Consortium. School lab computers. The Oregon Trail taught a generation that choices have consequences and rivers kill.

games.name: The Oregon Trail
games.note: the first game. 65M+ copies. you have died of dysentery.

games.name: The Amazon Trail
games.note: canoe up the Amazon, back through time. same classroom, same MECC, different river.

games.name: The Yukon Trail
games.note: Gold Rush era. the trail goes north.

games.name: Africa Trail
games.note: bicycle across Africa. the trail goes south.

games.name: Number Munchers
games.note: eat the right numbers. dodge the troggles.

games.name: Super Munchers
games.note: trivia action. eat words that match the clue.

games.name: Word Munchers
games.note: vowel sounds. the original edutainment.

games.name: Oregon Trail Deluxe
games.note: the graphical upgrade. same dysentery, better pixels.

games.name: Oregon Trail II
games.note: full CD-ROM era. voice acting. the trail gets cinematic.

sierra_online.label: Sierra On-Line (19801998)
sierra_online.note: Roberta Williams, Ken Williams. Oakhurst, California. They invented the graphic adventure game. King's Quest, Space Quest, Leisure Suit Larry, Gabriel Knight. The parser that understood you.

games.name: Mystery House
games.note: FIRST graphic adventure game ever. Released to public domain 1987 by Sierra. Roberta Williams wrote it.

games.name: King's Quest IIV
games.note: AGI/SCI engine. ScummVM plays them on anything. GOG sells the data cheap.

games.name: Space Quest IVI
games.note: Roger Wilco. janitor. space hero by accident.

games.name: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Fathers
games.note: New Orleans voodoo mystery. Jane Jensen. Tim Curry voiced Gabriel.

games.name: Leisure Suit Larry
games.note: Al Lowe. the age verification quiz was harder than the game.

games.name: Outpost (OPHD)
games.note: space colony sim. open-source remake by OutpostUniverse.

lucasarts_revolution.label: LucasArts / Revolution / Point-and-Click (19871998)
lucasarts_revolution.note: SCUMM engine. Ron Gilbert. Tim Schafer. Monkey Island. Full Throttle. The art of the adventure game.

freeware_via_scummvm.name: Beneath a Steel Sky
freeware_via_scummvm.note: cyberpunk dystopia. free forever. Revolution gave it to the world.

freeware_via_scummvm.name: Flight of the Amazon Queen
freeware_via_scummvm.note: pulp adventure. Indiana Jones meets Amelia Earhart. free.

freeware_via_scummvm.name: Lure of the Temptress
freeware_via_scummvm.note: Revolution's first. they gave this one away too.

commercial_via_scummvm: Indiana Jones & the Fate of Atlantis (LucasArts)
lucasarts_revolution.note_commercial: Buy cheap on GOG/Steam. ScummVM runs them everywhere. 120+ games supported.

open_source_remakes.label: Open Source Remakes — the big ones
open_source_remakes.note: full open-source reimplementations. play free, play forever.

games.name: OpenTTD
games.note: Chris Sawyer's masterpiece, fully reimplemented. free graphics included.

games.name: OpenRCT2
games.note: Chris Sawyer again. multiplayer added. still needs the original game files.

games.name: FreeCiv
games.note: Civ I/II reimplemented. fully free. play in browser via freecivweb.

games.name: Unciv
games.note: Civ V open-source. Android + desktop. surprisingly faithful.

games.name: OpenRA
games.note: Westwood RTS classics, rebuilt. multiplayer works. active community.

games.name: OpenMW
games.note: Morrowind engine reimplemented. needs game files but plays better than original.

games.name: OpenLara
games.note: Tomb Raider in your browser. Lara runs again.

games.name: Julius / Augustus
games.note: Caesar III rebuilt. build Rome again.

games.name: fheroes2
games.original: Heroes of Might and Magic II (1996)
games.note: HoMM2 reimplemented. free demo data included. the full game works too.

games.name: CorsixTH
games.note: Theme Hospital rebuilt. still funny. still catches bloaty head.

games.name: OpenDUNE
games.note: THE first RTS. Westwood invented the genre. rebuilt.

games.name: Open Fodder
games.note: Sensible Software classic. plays in browser. 7 demos bundled free.

games.name: openage
games.note: AoE2 engine clone. wololo.

games.name: OpenSC2K
games.note: SimCity 2000 reimplemented. build the city.

games.name: FreeCol
games.note: Colonization rebuilt. fully free.

games.name: OpenGOAL
games.note: Jak & Daxter decompiled to native PC. needs original disc.

games.name: Space Cadet Pinball
games.note: the Windows pinball game everyone played. decompiled. runs everywhere.

games.name: Clone Hero
games.note: Guitar Hero for PC. custom songs. active community.

dos_browser_archive.label: Internet Archive DOS Collection
dos_browser_archive.note: thousands of DOS games playable free in browser via EM-DOSBOX. legal preservation.

highlights.name: Street Rod (1989)
highlights.note: buy hot rods, race for money

highlights.name: Lemmings (1991)
highlights.note: DMA Design before they made GTA

highlights.name: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego? (1985)
highlights.note: geography game that launched a TV show

tools.name: DOSBox Online
tools.note: play any DOS game in browser. paste archive.org URL.

tools.name: js-dos
tools.note: DOSBox compiled to WASM. embed DOS games anywhere.

scummvm_engine.label: ScummVM — the universal adventure engine
scummvm_engine.note: one engine to run them all. Sierra AGI/SCI, LucasArts SCUMM, Revolution Virtual Theatre. 325+ games.

osgameclones.note: the definitive database. community-maintained. YAML files. every open-source game clone.

awesome_game_remakes.note: curated awesome list. organized by genre.

awesome_game_revivals.note: revivals including multiplayer mods and private servers.

membrane_mapping.note: the Oregon Trail IS the membrane. you set out with supplies, make choices, encounter random events, try not to die. the 404 IS dysentery.
membrane_mapping.oregon_trail_is: the membrane journey — independence to oregon, eastgate to westgate
membrane_mapping.amazon_trail_is: the canoe upstream — reverse transcriptase, going BACK through time
membrane_mapping.scummvm_is: the Klein fold — one engine that plays everything, like our _worker.js SHOULD be doing
membrane_mapping.archive_org_is: the Library of Alexandria — preservation IS the membrane
membrane_mapping.open_source_remakes_are: the sporePrint — code that outlives its creators
membrane_mapping.dosbox_wasm_is: the neutrino — passes through everything, disturbs nothing, runs in the browser
membrane_mapping.the_parser_that_understood_you: Sierra's text parser ? our MCP tools/call ? same thing, 40 years later

steam_frame_relevance.note: the Steam Frame in the living room can RUN all of these. SteamOS + Proton + DOSBox + ScummVM = every classic game on your TV.
